overall_summary: The performance data is extremely small (views range between 2 and 20 with zero engagement), meaning statistical confidence is very low. However, slightly higher initial reach is observed in content focusing on past connections and phone-related triggers ('रिश्ते' and 'पुराानी यादें'), while very abstract late-night hooks ('ओवरथिंकिंग') underperformed in this small sample.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video A_eLARoegnw ('आज भी फोन में तुम्हारा नाम सुरक्षित है,') received 20 views, the highest in the batch.
winning_patterns.action: Use physical relics of a relationship (old contact names, saved chats) as anchor points for the hook.

weak_patterns.evidence: Video WvZxup1LQYo ('आधी रात को खाली चैट देखना') and G0gKV1p3ZHc ('रात के दो बजे') had low impressions and views (2 and 11).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid starting purely with time stamps; anchor the scene in a physical object or immediate action first.
